startHere: This sheet holds every law, bill, quote and word on the Face Value site. The site reads what you publish from here.
The script fills this in. Anything you type here is ignored.
Column names. Hover a header to read its note. Please don't rename them.
Must fix. Preview and Deploy stop until it is fixed.
Check this. For example, a law nobody has re-read in 6 months, or text that is too long.
Unclear. The law has an open question about how to count it.
Approved. This wording goes live at the next Deploy.
Draft. Shows on the preview only.
Ready for review. Shows on the preview only, and waits for Jake.
Edit the white cells. Use the dropdowns and checkboxes where there are any.
Face Value › Check for problems. Fix every error it lists. Read the heads-ups.
Face Value › Preview changes, then Face Value › Open preview. Look at your change on the preview page.
If you changed wording, set its Status to Ready for review. Jake marks it Approved.
Face Value › Deploy to live site…. Read the list of changes, then press Deploy now. The site updates in about a minute.
Words on the page, Protections, Stories and Glossary each have a Status column.
Preview shows every row, whatever its Status.
Deploy publishes only Approved rows. Other rows keep the wording that is live today.
If you edit text that is Approved, its Status goes back to Ready for review on its own.
Jake Laperruque, or someone he names. Use Face Value › Wording to mark several rows at once.
Twice a year: in January, before state sessions start, and in early summer, before NCSL.
Open the Refresh checklist tab and work from the top. Tick each step and add the date.
Face Value › Every 6 months › Start a new refresh checklist saves the old ticks to the Change log and clears them.
The site may come offline about a year after launch. CDT decides whether to extend it or take it down.
Settings › Sunset decision by holds the date to decide. The sheet warns you 60 days before.
The offline.heading, offline.message, offline.linkText and offline.linkUrl rows on Words on the page must be Approved first.
Set Settings › Site status to Offline, then Deploy. Or set Settings › Offline from to a date, and the page goes offline that day.
The page shows only the offline message and link. The full steps are in sheet/RUNBOOK.md in the GitHub folder.
Face Value › Undo last deploy…. This puts back the version from before the last Deploy. The sheet keeps your newer edits.
A cell or tab got messed up
File › Version history › See version history. Pick a time before the mistake and restore it.
Open the backup copy made at the last refresh and copy the good rows back.
The Change log tab lists every Upgrade, Preview, Deploy and Undo, with a link to each change on GitHub.
Tabs named "v1 backup:" are a safety copy from the v2 upgrade. Leave them alone.
Bold. Use it for the key words.
Highlighted with an "Also allowed" label. Use it for an extra use the law permits.
Highlighted with an "Exception" label. Use it for a carve-out from the rule.
Every mark must be closed. Check for problems flags a mark that is left open.
Jake Laperruque. He leads the project and approves all wording.
The GitHub key owner. Their GitHub name shows in Settings › GitHub key (auto).
sheet/README.md and sheet/RUNBOOK.md in the site's GitHub folder.

checklist.how: File › Make a copy. Name it "Face Value sheet backup YYYY-MM". Keep it private.
Face Value › Setup › Check GitHub key. If it expires within 60 days, make a new key and use Set GitHub key.

checklist.step: January only: set the bill session
checklist.how: Settings › Current bill session = the new year, for example 2027.
Compare each Laws row with the official text. Update the row, Status, Last checked and Checked by.
Set last refresh's New or Amended laws back to Unchanged, unless they changed again.
Add new bills. On older bills, update Progress and Still alive.
Add a Quotes row for every new protection. Laws › Quotes (auto) shows what is missing.
Read States › Scorecard (auto). If it is right, fill Last checked and Checked by.
Settings › Research current through = the date the research is current to.
Fix Words on the page rows that mention dates or years. Set them to Ready for review.
Read each Ready for review row. Mark it Approved, or add a Reviewer note.
Open each story on the preview. Check its lesson still holds with the new data.
Face Value › Check for problems. Fix every error. Read every heads-up.
Preview changes, then Open preview. Check 5 states on a phone, including one with a new law.
Jake reads the preview and signs off. Note who and when in Notes.
Face Value › Deploy to live site…. Confirm the live site shows the new research date.
Settings › Next update due = 6 months from now. Update the calendar reminder.
If Settings › Sunset decision by is within 2 months, decide: extend the site or take it offline.
Face Value › Every 6 months › Check links. It is slow. Fix any broken link.

settingsHelp.GitHub owner: The GitHub account or organization that owns the site's repository.
settingsHelp.GitHub repo: The repository that holds the site.
settingsHelp.Branch: The branch the site is published from.
settingsHelp.Folder: The folder inside the repository that holds the site.
settingsHelp.Site address: The public web address of the site. It must end with a slash.
settingsHelp.New page address: Optional. The web address of the new page, used by Open preview.
settingsHelp.Research note: The line shown on the site about how current the research is. {date} is filled in from the next row.
settingsHelp.Research current through: The date the legal research is current to. Use the yyyy-mm-dd format.
settingsHelp.Current bill session: The newest bill year, for example 2026. Change it each January.
settingsHelp.Site status: Live or Offline. Offline makes the new page show only the offline message after the next Deploy.
settingsHelp.Offline from: Optional date. From this day on, the new page shows the offline message on its own.
settingsHelp.Offline message (auto): A copy of Words on the page › offline.message. Edit the wording on that tab.
settingsHelp.Next update due: When the next 6-month refresh is due. It turns amber 30 days before and red when past.
settingsHelp.Show out-of-date notice after: Optional date. After it, the new page tells visitors the research may be out of date.
settingsHelp.Sunset decision by: The date to decide whether to extend the site or take it offline. This stays in the sheet.
settingsHelp.Publishing sheet (auto): The ID of the one sheet allowed to Preview and Deploy. A copy can't publish until someone uses Setup › Publish from this sheet.
settingsHelp.Last preview (auto): When the last Preview ran, and who ran it.
settingsHelp.Last deploy (auto): When the last Deploy ran, and who ran it.
settingsHelp.GitHub key (auto): The result of the last key check: who owns the key and when it expires.
settingsHelp.Sheet version (auto): The sheet and script version, and the date of the upgrade.
